sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_books" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "_extras" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "edition_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_display" TEXT NOT NULL, "format" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_sha256" TEXT NULL, "file_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "storage_object_path" TEXT NULL, "ref_pages_total" INTEGER NULL, "ref_page_version" INTEGER NULL, "chapters_total" INTEGER NULL, "cover_ref" TEXT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NULL, "added_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, "last_opened_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 500), CHECK (length(author_display) BETWEEN 1 AND 500), CHECK (format IN ('epub','pdf','physical')), CHECK (status IN ('want_to_read','reading','finished','abandoned')), CHECK (content_sha256 IS NULL OR (length(content_sha256) = 64 AND content_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), CHECK (file_bytes >= 0), CHECK (ref_pages_total > 0), CHECK (chapters_total > 0), CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_positions" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "_extras" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "locator" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_page" INTEGER NOT NULL, "chapter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "progression" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (json_valid(locator) AND json_type(locator) = 'object'), CHECK (ref_page > 0), CHECK (chapter_index >= 0), CHECK (CAST(progression AS REAL) BETWEEN 0 AND 1)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_sessions" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "_extras" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ref_page_from" INTEGER NULL, "ref_page_to" INTEGER NULL, "pages_viewed" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (active_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 86400), CHECK (pages_viewed >= 0), CHECK (source IN ('auto','timer','manual')), CHECK (julianday(ended_at) >= julianday(started_at))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bookmarks" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "_extras" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "locator" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_page" INTEGER NOT NULL, "chapter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "excerpt" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (json_valid(locator) AND json_type(locator) = 'object'), CHECK (ref_page > 0), CHECK (chapter_index >= 0), CHECK (length(excerpt) <= 280)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ink_layers" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "_extras" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "anchor" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_lines" INTEGER NULL, "collapsed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("collapsed" IN (0, 1)), "strokes_b64" TEXT NOT NULL, "stroke_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "codec_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind IN ('over_text','space')), CHECK (json_valid(anchor) AND json_type(anchor) = 'object'), CHECK (space_lines BETWEEN 1 AND 12), CHECK (stroke_count >= 0), CHECK ((kind = 'space') = (space_lines IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (length(strokes_b64) <= 349528)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "annotations" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "_extras" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'selection', "anchor" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_page" INTEGER NOT NULL, "chapter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "style" TEXT NULL, "fill_height" TEXT NULL, "note_text" TEXT NULL, "ink_layer_id" TEXT NULL, "shared_club_post_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind IN ('highlight','note','handwriting','drawing')), CHECK (source IN ('selection','ink')), CHECK (json_valid(anchor) AND json_type(anchor) = 'object'), CHECK (ref_page > 0), CHECK (chapter_index >= 0), CHECK (style IN ('fill','underline','wavy')), CHECK (fill_height IN ('low','medium','high')), CHECK (length(note_text) <= 10000), CHECK ((kind = 'note') = (note_text IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (kind NOT IN ('handwriting','drawing') OR ink_layer_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (kind <> 'highlight' OR (color IS NOT NULL AND style IS NOT NULL))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "highlight_labels" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "_extras" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 24)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reader_settings" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "_extras" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "font_step" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "font_family" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'literata', "paper" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'creme', "line_spacing" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medio', "margins" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'media', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (font_step BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK (font_family IN ('literata','lora','figtree','atkinson')), CHECK (paper IN ('creme','branco','sepia','noite')), CHECK (line_spacing IN ('justo','medio','solto')), CHECK (margins IN ('estreita','media','larga')), CHECK (id = user_id)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pen_presets" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "_extras" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pen_tip" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ballpoint', "pen_width_mm" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.2', "pen_color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#FF552E', "favorite_colors" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '["#FF552E","#552CB7","#058CD7","#00995E","#F2A815","#1A1714"]', "stroke_size" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium', "highlighter_style" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fill', "highlighter_height" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium', "highlighter_color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#FED170', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (pen_tip IN ('ballpoint','fountain','brush')), CHECK (CAST(pen_width_mm AS REAL) BETWEEN 0.3 AND 4.0), CHECK (json_valid(favorite_colors) AND json_type(favorite_colors) = 'array' AND json_array_length(favorite_colors) <= 12), CHECK (stroke_size IN ('thin','medium','thick')), CHECK (highlighter_style IN ('fill','underline','wavy')), CHECK (highlighter_height IN ('low','medium','high')), CHECK (id = user_id)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_goals" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "version_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "_extras" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "daily_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "badge_target_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (daily_minutes BETWEEN 5 AND 600), CHECK (badge_target_days BETWEEN 1 AND 365), CHECK (id = user_id)) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kv" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_files" ("user_book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_book_id"), CHECK (upload_state IN ('none','pending','uploading','uploaded','failed')), CHECK (bytes >= 0)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_content_index" ("user_book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_page_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "spine_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "char_counts_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "toc_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_pages_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "built_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_book_id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "page_layout_cache" ("user_book_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "settings_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "viewport" TEXT NOT NULL, "fonts_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "breaks" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_book_id", "settings_hash", "viewport", "fonts_version")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_cache" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "license" TEXT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"), CHECK (kind IN ('isbn','search')), CHECK (json_valid(payload))) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "social_cache" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"), CHECK (json_valid(payload))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_social_ops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (json_valid(payload)), CHECK (attempts >= 0)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_rejections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "rejected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_ignored_deletes" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX user_books_user_idx ON user_books (user_id, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX reading_sessions_book_idx ON reading_sessions (user_book_id)
CREATE INDEX reading_sessions_started_idx ON reading_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX bookmarks_book_idx ON bookmarks (user_book_id, ref_page)
CREATE INDEX ink_layers_book_idx ON ink_layers (user_book_id)
CREATE INDEX annotations_book_page_idx ON annotations (user_book_id, ref_page)
CREATE INDEX annotations_parent_idx ON annotations (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX annotations_ink_idx ON annotations (ink_layer_id)
